line.name: Lampert Baba Yaga
line.background_text: Baba Yaga is a limited-edition Lampert Cigars release manufactured at Tabacos de Costa Rica, marking a departure from the brand's usual Nicaraguan (1675) and Dominican (1593) production. Named after the mythical witch of Slavic folklore, the line was deliberately shrouded in mystery at launch, with founder Dr. Stefan Lampert withholding binder and filler details, saying the blend was 'created to offer something different - something that captures mystery, strength, and craftsmanship in one cigar.' Announced/released in June 2026 in a single Toro vitola.
